pages.text: $(lilomon)$(#503a30)Beyond false temples, i lie in the first. I can almost hear ghostly steps of my past self. His fall made his stars to fade. to fracture and turn into shards with dismay.
$(lilomon)$(#503a30)the dark may scare me, but i hope my brother forgives his own grief, for that fear, is what i pray for dad to save...
